Before treatment

The technology behind the care

Counselors are the heart of the program. Aegis is its early-warning system — live relapse prediction that makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, during treatment or after discharge.

Aegis — a shield between you and relapse

Relapse rarely arrives out of nowhere. It builds quietly: a couple of missed check-ins, a week of broken sleep, more time alone. Aegis reads those signals live — applying our proprietary methods to the KPIs that actually drive risk — and turns them into a simple 1–100 risk score for every client, updated as your days unfold. It puts the reasons in front of your counselor, not just a number, so help is specific — and arrives beforehand, while there's still time to change the outcome.

1–40LowSteady. Keep the routine that's working.
41–75ElevatedWarning signs are stacking up. Time to lean on the plan.
76–100HighYour counselor is alerted and reaches out. At 95+, relapse within the next day is likely without intervention.

In development: the TDH smart ring

We're developing a biometric smart ring — heart rate variability, sleep, skin temperature, and stress signals — to feed Aegis even earlier warning. The ring is a one-time $249 purchase with a Basic plan, and it's coming after the app: we'd rather ship it right than ship it fast.

About True Dynamic Health

Most recovery programs ask you to rebuild your life around their building, their hours, and their waiting room. True Dynamic Health was built the other way around: real clinical care — a counselor who knows you, a plan built for your life — delivered online, with daily support in your pocket for the 167 hours a week you aren't in session.

True Dynamic Health is an ecosystem, not a single program — the umbrella over the full continuum of care. We're there before treatment, helping people find the right level of care and connecting them into rehab; during treatment, with weekly 1:1 telehealth sessions, an app for check-ins, lessons, and an SOS line to your counselor, plus support meetings and a recovery podcast; and after discharge, when most programs disappear. That's where Aegis — our live relapse-prediction technology — matters most: it reads the quiet warning signs so a hard week gets help before it becomes a relapse. We're based in Anaheim, California, and serve clients wherever they are.

Recovery isn't a 30-day event. It's a daily practice. We built the program we'd want standing next to us every one of those days.

Frequently asked questions

How does online rehabilitation actually work?
You meet your counselor by secure video each week, follow a structured lesson plan in the app, and check in daily. Support meetings, the craving tracker, and your counselor's messages all live in the same place. It's a real program with real clinical structure — it just doesn't require you to drive to a facility.
What does it cost?
Free tools (meeting finder, check-ins, podcast) cost nothing. Basic is $29.99/month or $199/year for the full app and lesson library. Premium is $299/month and adds weekly 1:1 counselor sessions, a peer recovery support specialist, and doctor/MAT access. A family add-on is $9.99/month. A structured 90-day program through insurance runs approximately $12,000.
Do you take insurance?
Yes — for the structured 90-day intensive program, which includes medication management and quick MAT access. Premium also includes doctor and medication (MAT) access with or without insurance. Contact us and we'll walk through what your coverage can do before you commit to anything.
What is Aegis?
Aegis is our live relapse-prediction system — a shield between you and relapse. Using our proprietary methods and the KPIs that drive risk, it turns everyday signals (missed check-ins, irregular sleep, isolation) into a 1–100 risk score your counselor can see, along with the reasons behind it. When risk climbs, your counselor reaches out early — before a hard day becomes a relapse.
Is my information private?
Yes. Check-ins and journal entries are encrypted, session notes stay between you and your counselor, and family members on your plan only see what you choose to share. We don't sell your data — ever.
Can my family be part of my recovery?
That's exactly what the $9.99/month family add-on is for. Loved ones can track progress alongside you and get notified when you're slipping — so the people in your corner can actually show up when it counts.
What if I'm in crisis?
Call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) any time, or call 911 in an emergency. Inside the program, the app's SOS button alerts your counselor — but for immediate danger, 988 and 911 come first.
